value.title: Uniform receiver-curve approximation and relaxed 30-row stability
value.statement: Premise-bound to the accepted private-message 30-row system and posterior-measure reduction, every binary-input receiver curve satisfies |J_A(p)-J_A(p')| ≤ 2h_2(|p-p'|). Generalized receivers represented by Borel posterior measures on [0,1] with mean 1/2 form a compact receiver-curve subset of C([0,1]), and finite-output receiver curves are uniformly dense in it. For every N-point grid Q containing {0,1/2,1}, each generalized receiver has an at-most-N-output replacement that matches its curve exactly on Q and has sup-norm error at most min{1,4h_2(Δ_Q)}, where Δ_Q is the grid mesh radius; on a reflection-closed grid this construction preserves a receiver pair that is already reflected. If G and K are replaced by curves within ε_G and ε_K, respectively, the right side of each accepted row r changes in absolute value by at most a_r ε_G+b_r ε_K for the audited row-specific coefficients, and hence by at most 4ε_G+4ε_K universally. Thus a hierarchy feasible for the original receivers remains feasible for the approximating receivers under those explicit row relaxations, and any fixed strictly feasible witness persists under sufficiently fine approximations.
scopeQualifications: Computational attestations check the encoded dependency list, 30-row coefficient algebra, global coefficient bound, and tested grid formulas; the entropy, compactness, Carathéodory, and arbitrary-grid arguments are established mathematically rather than by those computations.
Feasibility is established under explicit row relaxations; no unrelaxed optimized-value convergence is proved.
No exact full-functional cardinality bound, minimax interchange, numerical capacity improvement, or exact sum-capacity is established.
The approximation result preserves an already reflected receiver pair on a reflection-closed grid; it does not symmetrize arbitrary pairs or establish reflected optimality.
Validity is premise-bound to the accepted 30-row system from e3c1036ca607539a5ebcddf3058e6014ac5c1cd9, including its external theorem premise.

proofs: A common-mixture entropy argument bounds separately the changes in input entropy and conditional input entropy, proving the alphabet-independent modulus |J_A(p)-J_A(p')| ≤ 2h_2(|p-p'|).
Weak compactness of mean-one-half posterior measures, continuity of the receiver-curve integrand, and the common modulus establish compactness of the generalized receiver-curve image in the sup norm.

Carathéodory reduction matches the posterior mean and all nonendpoint grid samples using at most N atoms. Exact grid matching combined with the common modulus yields the stated uniform approximation bound; reflection of the reduced measure preserves an already reflected pair on reflection-closed grids.

Posterior conditioning expresses each receiver-bearing mutual-information term through complete receiver curves. Applying the audited term weights row by row gives the coefficients (a_r,b_r), the universal (4,4) bound, relaxed feasibility in both replacement directions, and persistence when every original row has sufficient strict slack.
methods: Weak compactness and equicontinuity in C([0,1])
computations: The submitted exact standard-library checker independently rebuilds the accepted generic length-three 30-row system, combines identical signed receiver terms, verifies every audited (a_r,b_r) pair and the global (4,4) bound, checks the declared dependency order, and tests the stated uniform-grid support and mesh formulas.
tools: The submitted no-argument Python standard-library verifier performs the mechanical dependency, row-coefficient, and uniform-grid audits; it does not computationally prove the analytic entropy, compactness, or arbitrary-grid arguments.

value.title: Premise-bound Theorem-9/GK converse foundations
value.objective: Develop the full auxiliary-receiver Theorem-9 system into a rigorous private-message BSSC converse framework, separating premise authentication from conditional specialization, receiver reduction, and optimization of the resulting GK-type bound.
value.currentStateSummary: Conditional on the exact cited Theorem 9 outer-bound premise encoded in theorem9_spec.json, the private-message specialization is an independently generated 30-row system preserved by input-only product-marginal receiver replacement, yielding C_sum≤inf_{G,K}B(G,K), V_Q(G,K)≤V(1/2;G,K)≤B(G,K), and a finite V_0(g,k) on its realizable domain. Generalized mean-one-half posterior-measure receivers now give a compact subset of C([0,1]); all binary-input receiver curves share the modulus |J_A(p)-J_A(p')|≤2h_2(|p-p'|), and finite-output curves are uniformly dense. On every N-point grid containing {0,1/2,1}, a generalized receiver has an exact at-most-N-output grid match with sup-norm error at most min{1,4h_2(Δ_Q)}; already reflected pairs are preserved on reflection-closed grids. Perturbing G and K by ε_G and ε_K changes each accepted row right side by its audited a_r ε_G+b_r ε_K bound, universally at most 4ε_G+4ε_K, so explicitly relaxed feasibility transfers and fixed strictly feasible witnesses persist under fine approximation. This does not prove unrelaxed optimized-value convergence, a full-functional cardinality bound, minimax interchange, or reflected optimality. On Q0, both finite-receiver infima equal c=h_2(1/4)-1/2, and the established floor gives a necessary midpoint window below 2c. Separately, one specified exact-decimal receiver pair has a continuous weak-duality certificate conditionally establishing C_sum≤0.369296945969202842443; receiver and dual optimality, matching achievability, exact capacity, and authentication of the external theorem remain unresolved.
value.localResidualSummary: Independently authenticate or re-prove the cited outer-bound premise and its quantifier structure. Use the compact receiver-curve completion and explicit row-stability bounds only with a justified treatment of active rate-free rows, boundary feasibility, and near-optimal hierarchies sufficient to prove unrelaxed optimized-value convergence or attainment. Determine whether midpoint coercivity can be strengthened to global receiver control, optimize inf_{G,K}B(G,K), assess optimality of the certified fixed pair and dual face, and seek a matching achievable rate before any exact-capacity conclusion.

value.title: Canonical problem
value.currentStateSummary: Three complementary converse directions are established. Genuine deterministic finite-block private-message codes induce approximate dependence balance, a fixed encoder-coordinate map, and four compatible rate rows, while an explicit nonbinary witness obstructs the specified coarse entropy and finite copy-lemma route; fixed-cardinality auxiliaries and exact BSSC posterior consistency remain unresolved. The separately relaxed UV scalars tensorize, with receiver-skew symmetry giving B_br=B_avg and half-skew BSSC product values n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4), but these scalars do not establish capacity. Conditional on the exact encoded Gohari–Liu–Nair Theorem 9 premise, the private-message specialization is a 30-row system preserved by input-only product-marginal receiver replacement, yielding C_sum≤inf_{G,K}B(G,K). Generalized receiver curves now form a compact sup-norm family with finite-output curves uniformly dense: every binary-input receiver curve has modulus 2h_2, and every N-point grid containing {0,1/2,1} admits an exact at-most-N-output match with error at most min{1,4h_2(Δ_Q)}. Already reflected pairs remain reflected on reflection-closed grids. The 30 rows have audited receiver-curve perturbation coefficients bounded universally by (4,4), giving feasibility under explicit row relaxations and persistence of fixed strictly feasible witnesses under fine approximation. These results do not establish unrelaxed optimized-value convergence, full-functional cardinality, minimax interchange, reflected optimality, or a new capacity bound. On Q0, both finite-receiver infima equal c=h_2(1/4)-1/2 and an explicit floor gives a necessary midpoint window. For one specified exact-decimal receiver pair, a continuous weak-duality certificate conditionally gives C_sum≤0.369296945969202842443. The theorem premise remains unauthenticated, receiver and dual optimality and matching achievability are unknown, and the canonical capacity problem remains unresolved.
value.localResidualSummary: Authenticate or independently prove the full Theorem-9 premise. Convert compact receiver-curve approximation and explicit relaxed-row stability into an unrelaxed converse limit only by controlling active rate-free constraints, boundary behavior, and near-optimal feasibility margins; strengthen midpoint coercivity to global receiver control and determine whether the certified fixed pair is optimal. In parallel, derive exact binary-BSSC posterior and multiletter constraints for genuine code-induced laws and retain coupling or nested auxiliary structure absent from the additive relaxed UV scalars. Exact capacity still requires closing the converse gap and supplying a matching achievable rate.

placementAudit.rationale: The accepted claim is a reusable continuum-approximation and row-stability theorem for the existing premise-bound 30-row GK converse framework, so it belongs in the durable Theorem-9/GK foundations program. It strengthens that program’s finite-grid receiver reduction without creating a separate objective or changing hierarchy topology. The program and root summaries are updated because the result materially changes the available continuum bridge while leaving the unrelaxed optimization and capacity residuals open.
